titulo: The ENTIRE History of Coca-Cola in 11 Minutes
capitulos: The birth of the bottling system
Marketing wars and the New Coke
descricao:
Want to know how a failed medicine, invented by a wounded Civil War colonel addicted to morphine, grew into a drink poured around two billion times every day? This is the entire history of Coca-Cola, from John Pemberton's Atlanta lab in 1886 to a brand sold in more than 200 countries today.

In its first year, Coca-Cola lost money. It sold about nine glasses a day, and Pemberton died two years later, never knowing what he had created.
